note: . Catalog of every per-car value the AI Brain Lab can change. The GUI builds the 'Everything' tab from this file; tools/gen_levers.py (DeepSeek task DS2) turns it into dll/abl_levers.h for the plugin. Order = lever index in shared memory (APPEND ONLY, never reorder or reuse an index). DS1 census 2026-10-03: 12 seeds verified+corrected, 1 seed rejected (start_stalls), 16 new verified entries appended; evidence and open questions in trials/levers_census_2026-10-03.md. Field reference: see 'fields' below.

fields.family: GUI section; keep to the families list
fields.label: plain words, max ~32 chars, no hex
fields.help: one or two sentences: what you will SEE the car do; hover text
fields.scope: car (vehicle struct offset) | global (absolute data address)
fields.offset: hex vehicle offset (scope car) or absolute address (scope global)
fields.lo, hi, step: slider bounds; the plugin refuses anything outside lo..hi
fields.action: control action: list of {offset, value or 'lap+N' or 'now+N'} writes done once, in order
fields.apply: pre (write before AIMainUpdate: inputs the tick reads) | post (after AIMainUpdate: tick outputs) | once (latched: write once, restore on release)
fields.restore: true = plugin restores the AI's own value on untick / RELEASE ALL / unload
fields.danger: none | confirm (GUI asks first) | never (must not be in this file: 0x3D6C, 0x4410, 0x4064, 0x45F4, 0x454C, 0x10C0, 0x33C8, 0x45FC)
fields.tier: FACT | CONFIRMED | DERIVED | GUESS (of the meaning)
fields.evidence: decompile file + line, finding id, or live check record
fields.quick: optional: name of the v2 Quick-tab field this lever drives instead of the v3 engine (one write path per offset). gen_levers.py must skip these.

levers.label: Wet-weather skill
levers.help: How much rain slows this driver: the wet factor is 1 - wetness x this. Higher = MORE slowdown (.rcd RAINABILITY / 100, scaled by difficulty).
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:98-102 parses rcd RainAbility, :144-150 scales it (x0.01 x GlobalDifficultyScalar) and bakes 0x4580 = 1 - wetness*this; AIPushLap_0042a180.c:33-37 reads it and refreshes 0x4580 on each push lap. Only writer = sub_424080 (profile load). data_index.json rcd RainAbility 0.4..16.5 -> field 0.004..0.16; bounds 0..0.30 (min/2..max*2, clipped).

levers.label: Qualifying skill
levers.help: Driver's .rcd QUALIFYINGABILITY turned into pace for simulated sessions. No live AI-tick reader was found, so a watched race should not change.
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:86-91 writes (22-Q)/22 once at profile load; readers RandomVariationScaler_004bea10.c:14 and sub_4BE760_004be760.c:36,56 (simulation/rating maths). data_index rcd QualifyingAbility 1.2..23.75 -> field -0.08..0.95; physical clamp 0..1.

levers.label: Driver style variant
levers.help: The driver's random style variant 0/1/2 (.rcd pick). AISteering turns it into a small steering-line bias (+1 / 0 / -1 m), applied only near the race start.
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:62-65 rand%3 at profile load (only writer); AISteering_004270a0.c:271-284 sole reader, applied while SessionTime < RaceTimeOffset+2.5 (start window only).

levers.label: Corner speed target x
levers.help: Multiplies every corner speed target each tick. 1.0 = the game; above ~1.1 is beyond tyre grip (live: 1.5 sent a car off).
levers.evidence: AIRacingLine_00425920.c:209 multiplies the corner score by it; AISteering_004270a0.c:298 resets it to 1.0 on every call, so it must be rewritten before the AIRacingLine stage of each tick (apply pre = per-tick); AIDriverStructInit_00424790.c:56 / CameraViewportFrustumInitialization_00424b20.c:45 init 1.0. No data_index key; bounds from the v2 panel (+-20%) and the live 1.10 grip limit.

levers.label: Launch strength
levers.help: Throttle ramp at the race start (.rcd STARTSDRY/STARTSWET blend). Below 1 caps the start throttle; 1.5 = no cap. Only read during the race start: set it before the lights.
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:164-175 (only writer, profile load); AISteeringCorrection_00426cf0.c:117-129 uses it as the start throttle cap while byte_5C3160; AIRacingLine_00425920.c:329 reads it too. Formula range 0.9..1.4; bounds 0.5..1.5.

levers.label: Stall chance at the start
levers.help: REJECTED by DS1: the stall roll reads this inside the .rcd parse itself, so a live write is never read.
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:80-85,177-195: the parse-time stall roll is the only reader of 0x44BC. A live write after the parse is never read; the parse overwrites a pre-session write. Census: trials/levers_census_2026-10-03.md (open question 2).

levers.label: Pit this lap (organic stop)
levers.help: Makes the car come in for a normal stop: it drives the pit lane, gets serviced and rejoins by itself. Nothing is forced.
levers.evidence: finding:f1c-ai-pitstop-activation-schedule-plus-decision-timer (live Monza 2026-08-03); sub_429960_00429960.c:165,252-253 fills the stop-lap row (0x4590); AIPushLap_0042a180.c:40-41 pits when row[cursor] <= lap; AIMainUpdate_00424e70.c:185-191 consumes the 0x413C deadline (AIPushLap).

levers.label: Planned pit stops
levers.help: How many stops the car plans for the race.
levers.evidence: sub_429960_00429960.c:88-214 parses the plan (only writer, called from AIDriverStructInit_00424790.c:121 at session init); PitStopDecisionTireCompound_0042a3d0.c:22-27 compares the count with the cursor; AIPushLap_0042a180.c:40 uses row[cursor]. Bound 0..4 = plan size (name_index CONFIRMED).

levers.label: Next stop lap
levers.help: Lap of the next planned stop. The car checks it every few seconds and pits when its lap reaches it.
levers.evidence: sub_429960_00429960.c:165 (default = TotalRaceLaps), :252-253 (min 1) at session init; AIPushLap_0042a180.c:40 reads row[cursor] (0x4590) against the lap (0x403C) -> ForcePitExit. Bound 1..200 laps (race distances).

levers.label: Tyres for the next stop
levers.help: Compound the car will fit at its next stop (ids from the game's tyre-name table; not yet tested live).
levers.evidence: sub_429960_00429960.c:47 writes TireCompoundNameIDMapping(name) to 0x458C; AIPushLap_0042a180.c:42-58 compares it with the current tyre and wetness; ids from TireCompoundNameIDMapping_004a4830.c:3-11 (hard 2, soft 3, intermediate 4, wet 5, monsoon 6; 1 = default/unmapped).

levers.label: Engine life left
levers.help: Countdown to an engine failure, in seconds of running. Live healthy range 20000-41000 s; 0 = the engine goes now.
levers.evidence: AIMainUpdate_00424e70.c:196-206 writes the matching component slot from RACEEVENTS; FuelConsumptionAndWear_004ed960.c:116-119 decrements veh+0x3D70 by dt every tick; name_index 0x3D70 EngineLifeRemaining POKE-PROVEN 2026-07-25 (0.5 -> ReasonCode 1 within 0.2 s). Bounds 0..50000 s, step 100.

levers.label: Scheduled stall time
levers.help: Session time (s) when this car stalls and parks (mode 4/5). 0 = now; 'AI none' (FLT_MAX) = never. The game disarms it after it fires.
levers.evidence: AIMainUpdate_00424e70.c:89 re-arms from a RACEEVENTS STALL slot; :218-236 consumes it (driver status 4/5, flags cleared, 0x4170 reset to FLT_MAX); AIDriverStructInit_00424790.c:28 init FLT_MAX. Bound 0..20000 s (session length), step 100.

levers.label: Highest gear allowed
levers.help: The auto-shift never goes above this gear. Lower = slower on straights.
levers.evidence: PhysicsGearShiftLogicWithThresholds_00426330.c:27-29 upshifts only while current gear (0x39FC) < 0x3A04, so holding a lower value caps the top gear. No writer of the vehicle-base 0x3A04 in functions/*.c; the +14852 writes in RaceStartCountdownStateUpdate_004ef930.c:12-35, SuspensionAndWheelPhysics_004e5f60.c:660 and BrakeCoolingPostTreatment_004e5080.c:11-12 appear to use a veh+0xC base -> 0x3A10 shift lockout (OPEN QUESTION). Applied as pre (per-tick hold); bounds 1..7 gears.

levers.label: Pace floor (baseline)
levers.help: The pace the AI drifts back to in clean air; the live pace value walks to it at +-0.01 every 4 s. 1.0 = its full rating.
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:60,151-152 bakes it = (1 - RaceAbility/100) x GlobalDifficultyScalar (only writer, profile load); AIAbility_00429470.c:40-92 walks 0x453C toward this[4413] every 4 s; name_index 0x44F4 POKE-PROVEN 2026-07-26 (mid-race write sticks; pace follows in ~8 s).
levers.review: STOP 1 (Claude 2026-10-03): driven through the existing v2 Quick lever (one write path); gen_levers.py emits no engine entry for it.

levers.label: Pace push above floor
levers.help: How far above the floor the AI may push when it is chasing: target = floor + this. 0 = never pushes.
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:153 bakes it = (1 - baseline) x 0.67 (only writer); AIAbility_00429470.c:46,56 adds it to the floor; AIPushLap_0042a180.c:23 does the same each push lap.
levers.review: STOP 1 (Claude 2026-10-03): driven through the existing v2 Quick lever (one write path); gen_levers.py emits no engine entry for it.

levers.label: Traffic pace gamble
levers.help: Probability gate for stepping the pace up near stronger cars: higher = pushes more often.
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:154 bakes it = (22 - RaceAbility x 0.67)/22 (only writer); AIAbility_00429470.c:52-54 compares it against rand()%100 in the pace gate.
levers.review: STOP 1 (Claude 2026-10-03): driven through the existing v2 Quick lever (one write path); gen_levers.py emits no engine entry for it.

levers.label: Crash tendency
levers.help: The .rcd CRASH percentage feeding the AI's race incident gate. Statistical: raise it and watch several laps. 0 = never.
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:57,128-132 stores the raw rcd Crash value (only writer); AICollision_004bef60.c:30 uses veh+0x44D0 as the incident-probability term; name_index CrashPct CONFIRMED (2001 grid 2.4..31.2).
levers.review: STOP 1 (Claude 2026-10-03): driven through the existing v2 Quick lever (one write path); gen_levers.py emits no engine entry for it.

levers.label: Aggression (TRACKAGGRESSION)
levers.help: Traffic thresholds: follow gap, side-by-side window, overtake pressure. 0.69 = the game's AI-realism default.
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:92-97,144-147 = AIRealism x rcd TrackAggression (min 0.01), only writer besides AIDriverStructInit_00424790.c:57 default; AISteering_004270a0.c:455-622 reads it for the gap/window/pressure terms; name_index CONFIRMED live 2026-07-26.
levers.review: STOP 1 (Claude 2026-10-03): driven through the existing v2 Quick lever (one write path); gen_levers.py emits no engine entry for it.

levers.label: Grip multiplier (CORNERINGMULT)
levers.help: Multiplies the tyre-force term of every corner speed target. The game bakes ~0.93-0.99; above ~1.1 is beyond grip.
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:122-127 (only writer, direct rcd value); AIComputePassScore_0042a780.c:4 and sub_426430_00426430.c:140 read it; v2 panel live 2026-10-03: x1.50 -> corner targets +52%, car off track. data_index rcd CorneringMult 0.931..0.99; bounds 0.85..1.20 (v2 tested range).
levers.review: STOP 1 (Claude 2026-10-03): driven through the existing v2 Quick lever (one write path); gen_levers.py emits no engine entry for it.

levers.label: Grip offset (CORNERINGADD)
levers.help: Adds m/s to every corner speed target. The game bakes ~1.4-3.5; negative slows every corner.
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:116-121 (only writer); AIComputePassScore_0042a780.c:4 / sub_426430_00426430.c:140 read the affine term; data_index rcd CorneringAdd 1.4..3.5 -> min/2..max*2 = 0.7..7, widened to +-10 for slowing.

levers.label: Braking confidence (PASSING)
levers.help: Braking look-ahead loss per step: higher = the AI believes it stops quicker, so it brakes later. 0.9..1.0 = game values.
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:110-115,160-163 bakes min(1, 0.9+Passing/1000) (only writer after AIDriverStructInit_00424790.c:58 default); AIRacingLine_00425920.c:264 uses it in the braking step; name_index PassingNorm CONFIRMED + v2 live.

levers.label: Brake build-up (RACEABILITY)
levers.help: How fast brake pressure ramps to its target; the AI uses 0.2 x this as its step.
levers.evidence: sub_424080_00424080.c:151,155-158 bakes (1 - RaceAbility/100) x difficulty (only writer); AIRacingLine_00425920.c:331 reads 0.2 x it as the ramp step; Overtaking_0042af70.c:13 reads it; data_index rcd RaceAbility 0.3..17.13 -> 0.795..0.957, bounds 0.05..1.5 (v2 tested).
levers.review: STOP 1 (Claude 2026-10-03): driven through the existing v2 Quick lever (one write path); gen_levers.py emits no engine entry for it.

levers.label: Max speed cap (m/s)
levers.help: Per-car top-speed cap in m/s. On track your value is the cap; the game may lower it in the pit lane.
levers.evidence: AIDriverStructInit_00424790.c:63 init 1e6 = no cap; AISteeringRacingLineCorrection_0042b0e0.c:139 and ParameterValueSetter_0042acd0.c:6 write it; AISteeringCorrection_00426cf0.c:80 applies it via TrackParameterMinimumClamp; v2 panel + mechanical_failures live writes. Bounds 5..120 m/s (18..432 km/h).

levers.label: Steering lock (rad)
levers.help: Heading error / this = steer command. Lower = sharper/twitchier, higher = lazier. Live ~0.4014 rad (23 deg).
levers.evidence: AIDriverStructInit_00424790.c:54 copies veh+0x396C (only writer); AISteeringRacingLineCorrection_0042b0e0.c:213,240 and sub_426100_00426100.c:37 divide the heading error by it; name_index steering_lock_divisor OBSERVED live 0.4014; v2.2 driver trait.

levers.label: Stuck patience (watchdog)
levers.help: Wrong-way/stuck counter limit before the car stops itself to recover. Game default 50; higher = keeps trying longer.
levers.evidence: AIDriverStructInit_00424790.c:71 init 50 (only writer); SteeringAngleController_00425670.c:62 compares the wrong-way counter (0x446C) against it and triggers the mode 1 recovery stop.

levers.label: Brakes life left (s)
levers.help: Countdown to a brakes failure in seconds of running. 0 = failure now.
levers.evidence: FuelConsumptionAndWear_004ed960.c:116-119 decrements veh+0x3D74 every tick; AIMainUpdate_00424e70.c:196-206 writes the matching slot from RACEEVENTS; FailureCategoryNameLookup_004bb730 maps ReasonCode 5 = brakes; name_index BrakesLifeRemaining CONFIRMED (same code path as the poke-proven engine slot).

levers.label: Gearbox life left (s)
levers.help: Countdown to a gearbox failure in seconds of running. 0 = failure now.
levers.evidence: FuelConsumptionAndWear_004ed960.c:116-119 decrements veh+0x3D78 every tick; AIMainUpdate_00424e70.c:196-206 writes the matching slot; ReasonCode 2 = gearbox (FailureCategoryNameLookup_004bb730); name_index GearboxLifeRemaining CONFIRMED.

levers.label: Suspension life left (s)
levers.help: Countdown to a suspension failure in seconds of running. 0 = failure now.
levers.evidence: FuelConsumptionAndWear_004ed960.c:116-119 decrements veh+0x3D7C every tick; AIMainUpdate_00424e70.c:196-206 writes the matching slot; ReasonCode 4 = suspension (FailureCategoryNameLookup_004bb730); name_index SuspensionLifeRemaining CONFIRMED.

levers.label: Park / stop
levers.help: 4 = park (garage wait; the car stops driving). 7 = brake to a stop, then back to race. 0 = normal.
levers.evidence: AIMainUpdate_00424e70.c:238-259: driver status 4/5 skips the whole AI stack; SteeringAngleController_00425670.c:34,72,78 writes 7/1/6; AIAbility_00429470.c:149-151 writes 4/5; v2 Park lever, owner-validated mode 4 (README lever table).
